facts.name: Robert L. Ostrov
facts.assignment: Hendry county civil, small claims, civil infractions, misdemeanor and criminal traffic; circuit assignments probate, juvenile delinquency and domestic violence. Judicial-order index states reassignment effectiveJune2,2025.

checklist.summary: Email Nancy Owens with case style/number, motion, time needed, plaintiff and defense attorneys and requester contact information.
Use the published assistant email for hearing requests; retain clerk filing and chambers submission channels separately.

Submit through the e-portal within10days after hearing; for an upcoming appearance/event, submit at least3business days beforehand. Supporting documents must already be visible in the clerk electronic file. Include complete service information and case style/number.

Proceedings default to in person. Submit motion and proposed order at least10days before hearing, or show good cause for shorter notice. Approved appearances use Zoom; assistant adds credentials to the order. Civil/small-claims trials ordinarily in person, with good-cause exception.
For an approved remote appearance, provide any evidence/courtesy copies in paper ahead of time; the court does not print emailed copies.
No separate general conferral instruction located in the profile; shared-rule review remains distinct.

facts.summary: County-civil hearing requests through Nancy Owens; proposed orders via e-portal and permission-based Zoom appearances.
facts.review_scope: Official profile contact/assignment and practical civil operating sections reviewed. Criminal plea attachment retained as official link only; substantive noncivil review unnecessary.
gaps: No individual judge email or separate assistant-only phone supplied.
